messages:
maria_partnerships: Quick kickoff for cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for telemetry webhook, publisher role setup, and trial SKU visibility. Who can take?

sam_engineer: I can own the webhook. Prefer HMAC signature + idempotency key. Need schema: event, sku, customer_id, timestamp.

tina_pm: Add events: install, activate_trial, convert, uninstall. Retry semantics (3 attempts, exp backoff) and a small payload. I'll update runbook with cloud-specific notes.

alex_ops: I'll create the AWS assume-role + minimal policy and a Terraform snippet. For GCP it's service account impersonation; Azure will be managed identity + role assignment.

leo_legal: We need explicit telemetry consent text and an opt-out URL. EU listings must mention data residency and KMS encryption. I'll drop exact copy to the drive.

sam_engineer: sample header: X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=HEX(HMAC_SHA256(secret, body)); X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>. Retries: 1s, 2s, 4s.

alex_ops: Will post role ARN + PR with terraform once ready. Publisher will attach role ARN in listing.

tina_pm: Plan: reviews done by Monday EOD, request publish window for Tuesday 09:00 PT. I'll create the checklist ticket.

infra-bot: CI: marketplace-webhook-staging build-85 passed. Health: https://staging-api.redwood.ai/marketplace/webhook/health -> 200 OK.

maria_partnerships: Awesome. Action items captured: webhook (sam), AWS/GCP/Azure steps (alex + tina), legal copy (leo). Will follow up in #partnerships. :rocket:
